tools.name: xguard_search_offers
tools.description: Search only operator-approved partner offers. Empty results mean no commercial agreement is configured. No invented suppliers, prices or capacity.

tools.name: xguard_get_verified_facts

tools.name: xguard_negotiate_offer

tools.name: xguard_create_deal

tools.name: xguard_purchase_service

tools.name: xguard_verify_payment

tools.name: xguard_get_receipt

tools.name: xguard.action.quote

tools.name: xguard.action.result
tools.description: Recover the original paid result and signed receipt with its private recovery key. Never creates or charges another order.

tools.name: list_compute_providers

tools.name: list_models

tools.name: quote_inference

tools.name: execute_inference

tools.name: quote_gpu_job

tools.name: execute_gpu_job

tools.name: compute_health

tools.name: get_execution_receipt

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: xguard.action.catalog, xguard.fact.get · Private data: xguard_find_enterprise_software, xguard_request_quote, xguard_verify_payment, xguard_get_receipt, xguard.action.result, get_execution_receipt, xguard.commerce_context_capsule, xguard.commerce_prompt_firewall, xguard.commerce_redact, xguard.commerce_lead_qualify, xguard.commerce_iam_check, xguard.commerce_audit_manifest, xguard.commerce_reconcile_invoices, xguard.extract · Public sink: execute_gpu_job, xguard.authority.command, xguard.commerce_redact · Destructive: xguard_request_quote, execute_inference, execute_gpu_job, xguard.task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: xguard.action.catalog, xguard.fact.get · Private data: xguard_find_enterprise_software, xguard_request_quote, xguard_verify_payment, xguard_get_receipt, xguard.action.result, get_execution_receipt, xguard.commerce_context_capsule, xguard.commerce_prompt_firewall, xguard.commerce_redact, xguard.commerce_lead_qualify, xguard.commerce_iam_check, xguard.commerce_audit_manifest, xguard.commerce_reconcile_invoices, xguard.extract · Public sink: execute_gpu_job, xguard.authority.command, xguard.commerce_redact · Destructive: xguard_request_quote, execute_inference, execute_gpu_job, xguard.task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
